# NEOM Panels — Indian Wood-Panel Manufacturing

> NEOM Panels is an Indian wood-panel manufacturing company operating its own production facility in India. We manufacture calibrated wood-panel substrates for serial furniture & OEM manufacturing, modular kitchens & wardrobes, commercial & architectural joinery, and moisture-resistant (MR) industrial packaging plywood. Home to product brands Starwoods and NEOM Packing Plywood.

## Brand & Manufacturing Hierarchy
- **Parent Company**: NEOM Panels (`https://neompanels-new.vercel.app`) — Slogan: *ENGINEERED EXCELLENCE, DESIGNED FOR SPACES*
- **Product Brand 1 (Furniture & Interiors)**: Starwoods (`https://neompanels-new.vercel.app/brands#starwoods`) — Wood-panel substrates for furniture manufacturers, modular kitchen and wardrobe fabricators, commercial interior contractors and trade partners.
- **Product Brand 2 (Industrial Packaging)**: NEOM Packing Plywood (`https://neompanels-new.vercel.app/brands/neom-packing-plywood`) — Moisture-resistant (MR) packaging-grade plywood for industrial packing cases, export crates, pallet collars, dividers and protective enclosures.

## Core Manufactured Wood-Panel Categories
1. **Calibrated Furniture & OEM Panels**: Uniform-thickness multi-ply panels engineered for CNC routing, clean edge-banding and serial furniture production.
2. **Modular Kitchen & Wardrobe Substrates**: Dimensionally stable plywood substrates suited for laminate, acrylic or veneer pressing across modular cabinetry and carcasses.
3. **Architectural Joinery & Commercial Project Panels**: Project-grade wood panels aligned with consultant specifications, tender schedules and commercial fit-out BOQs.
4. **Moisture-Resistant (MR) Industrial Packaging Plywood**: Practical MR packaging-grade plywood for heavy-duty packing cases, crates, dividers and liners.
